purpose: Web application for STEG to manage regions, vehicles, drivers, missions, fuel tickets and driver complaints.

roles.dg: National scope; manages regions and regional directors.
roles.dr: One-region scope; manages vehicles, drivers, missions, fuel tickets and complaints.
roles.chauffeur: Own missions; starts/closes missions and submits complaints.

regionRules: A region has a unique name and an address.
A region cannot be deleted while it has drivers, vehicles or missions.

dataModel.region: region(id_r PK AI, nom UNIQUE, adresse, id_dr UNIQUE nullable FK -> directeur_regional)

notes: Taux CAR is assumed to mean fuel level percentage until confirmed.
Fuel tickets, mission destination, separate starting values, authentication columns, planned allocation, complaint status and precise DR search scope are open gaps.
